# Battle of Jeddah

Battle of Jeddah may refer to:
*Siege of Jeddah (1517), a naval battle between the Ottoman Empire and the Portuguese Empire
*Siege of Jeddah (1520), a naval battle between the Ottoman Empire and the Portuguese Empire
*Battle of Jeddah (1813), between the Ottoman Empire and the First Saudi State
*Battle of Jeddah (1925), between the Kingdom of Hejaz and Sultanate of Nejd (Saudi Arabia)
